data.name: Kurban
data.gender_notes: Kurban is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Kurban is of Turkish origin and translates to 'devoted to Allah'. This name holds great significance in the Islamic faith, with the act of 'kurbani' or sacrifice being a fundamental part of religious practice. The name Kurban carries the meaning “Devoted to Allah” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Turkic tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kurban usually hope their child will grow to embody devoted to allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.

This practice is carried out as a symbol of the willingness to submit to the divine will of Allah, and to remember the sacrifice Prophet Ibrahim made for his faith.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Kurban is a profound reminder of the spiritual concept of selflessness and devotion to God. It emphasizes the importance of surrendering one's desires and actions to the divine will. The name carries a deep spiritual significance, encouraging the individual to lead a life of sacrifice and submission to God, just as the Prophet Ibrahim did when he was willing to sacrifice his only son, Ishmael.
